title: Reflection Substitution / Ownership Moves Across the Image
observed_structure: a reflective surface establishes a stable relation between subject and image
the reflected occupant, timing, or behavior changes
the substitution alters agency or ownership outside the mirror
dramatic_operations: separate physical presence from social or psychological claim
cinematic_affordances: different figure completing an established reflected gesture
reflection delayed or behaviorally independent through blocking and edit
reflected object retained after ownership changes
cultural_scope: general reflective structure; do not assign universal soul or identity meanings
transferable_structure: a stable reflected relation changes occupant or behavior, transferring an operative claim between image and world
non_transferable_surface: shattered mirrors, doubled faces, or copied mirror scenes used as identity shorthand
